SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_AnzsicClass_CRM] AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_AnzsicClass
AS(
    SELECT
     BCC.[VALUE] AS AnzsicClassCode
    ,BCC.DESCRIPTION  AS AnzsicClassName
    ,BCC.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BCC.CATEGORYID AS CategoryId
    ,'CRM' AS SourceSystemCode
    ,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES BCC 
WHERE BCC.ISLATEST = 1 AND CATEGORYTYPE = 'INDUSTRY_TYPE'

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_AnzsicClass FROM TEMP_BNKM_AnzsicClass;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_AnzsicClass_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
AnzsicClassCode
,AnzsicClassName
,FinancialInstitutionId
,CategoryId

)) HASHROW, AnzsicClassCode,FinancialInstitutionId,CategoryId
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_AnzsicClass 
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_AnzsicClass_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
AnzsicClassCode
,AnzsicClassName
,FinancialInstitutionId
,CategoryId
)) HASHROW, AnzsicClassCode, FinancialInstitutionId,CategoryId
FROM BNKM.AnzsicClass WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CRM'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_AnzsicClass_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CategoryId,TGT.CategoryId) AS CategoryId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.AnzsicClassCode,TGT.AnzsicClassCode) AS AnzsicClassCode
	,CASE
        WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_AnzsicClass_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_AnzsicClass_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CategoryId = TGT.CategoryId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.AnzsicClassCode = TGT.AnzsicClassCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_AnzsicClass_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_AnzsicClass_DELTA;


UPDATE TGT 
SET
 AnzsicClassCode = SRC.AnzsicClassCode
,AnzsicClassName = SRC.AnzsicClassName
,AnzsicClassDescription = NULL
,AnzsicGroupCode = NULL
,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,CategoryId = SRC.CategoryId
FROM BNKM.AnzsicClass TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_AnzsicClass_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CategoryId = TGT.CategoryId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.AnzsicClassCode = TGT.AnzsicClassCode AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_AnzsicClass SRC ON SRC.CategoryId = TGT.CategoryId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND SRC.AnzsicClassCode = TGT.AnzsicClassCode;
 

----INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.AnzsicClass
([AnzsicClassCode]
,[AnzsicClassName]
,[AnzsicClassDescription]
,[AnzsicGroupCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[CategoryId]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm] )

SELECT
     SRC.AnzsicClassCode AS AnzsicClassCode
    ,AnzsicClassName AS AnzsicClassName
    ,NULL AS AnzsicClassDescription
    ,NULL AS AnzsicGroupCode
    ,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,SRC.CategoryId AS CategoryId
    ,SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_AnzsicClass SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_AnzsicClass_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CategoryId = SRC.CategoryId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.AnzsicClassCode = SRC.AnzsicClassCode
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_AnzsicClass;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_AnzsicClass_DELTA;

END
GO
